mapper.select: SELECT uf.friend_id as friendID, u.user_name as friendName, COALESCE(f.nickname, u.user_nickname) as nickname, u.user_avatar as avatar, c.category_id as categoryID, CONCAT(LEAST(uf.user_id, uf.friend_id), '_', GREATEST(uf.user_id, uf.friend_id)) as chatId FROM biz_user_friend uf INNER JOIN biz_user u ON uf.friend_id = u.sys_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_friend f ON f.sys_friend_id = uf.friend_id AND f.friend_name = u.user_name AND f.creator_id = uf.user_id LEFT JOIN biz_category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.status = 1 ORDER BY c.category_id, f.is_top DESC, COALESCE(f.nickname, u.user_nickname)
